title: GTA6 Original Score Now Available for Preorder
description: Get the latest GTA6 news on GTA6 Hub: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Score is now available to preorder on CD and vinyl, featuring three hours of new music by Justice.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Original Score Now Available for Preorder

As the anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' next blockbuster continues to build, players are getting their first major look at the auditory experience of the game. According to a recent report by IGN Games, *Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Score* has officially been made available for preorder, offering fans an early taste of the game's musical landscape.

## A Three-Hour Electronic Journey by Justice

The upcoming original score is a massive three-hour compilation of entirely new music. What makes this release particularly exciting for music and gaming enthusiasts alike is that the score is composed by Justice, the acclaimed electronic music duo known for their distinctive, high-energy sound. Their production style promises to bring a unique atmospheric depth that should complement the signature satirical and gritty world of the franchise.

## CD and Vinyl Options for Collectors

For physical media collectors and audiophiles, Rockstar Games is offering robust formats for the release. The three-hour compilation is currently available to preorder on both traditional CD and classic vinyl records. This gives fans a tangible piece of the game's universe to collect well ahead of the title's launch.

While broader details regarding the full in-game radio stations and other contributing artists remain under wraps, the announcement of a dedicated, expansive original score highlights the immense scale and production value being poured into the audio design of GTA6.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar has always set the industry gold standard for in-game soundtracks, and enlisting Justice for a three-hour original score is a brilliant move. This release not only elevates the prestige of the game's audio profile but also gives physical collectors an absolute must-have item. It is a promising sign of the auditory excellence awaiting us.
